{{Top|leg}}
A '''sauna''' was a room that consisted of a steam or heat filled room, wherein the pores could be cleansed, and a pool or [[hot tub]]. Despite this, it proved hazardous, and often fatal, to species other than [[Human/Legends|humans]] because of the concentrated heat levels.

==History==
A sauna was aboard the [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|MedStar-class frigate]] and used daily by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]]. He kept the temperature of the sauna so excessively high, that entering it would blister the skin of most of the crew.<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
